annotations.title: INTRASTAT: reference tables and current thresholds

description: Returns, with no input, the INTRASTAT reference tables: the allowed Member States with their codes, the Northern Ireland case (XI, goods only) and the out-of-scope countries (San Marino from 01/10/2021, United Kingdom from 01/01/2021), all form sections with their description, and EVERY current threshold with amount, comparison criterion (> or >=), effect and precise legal SOURCE — including the goods-purchase threshold raised to €2,000,000 from period 01/2026 (Det. ADM 84415 of 03/02/2026). It also includes the filing deadline and the EXPLICIT list of what these tools do NOT produce (the ADM electronic file, the descriptions of the nature of transaction codes, the live VIES check). Use it to validate inputs before `intrastat_compose`, to populate a form, or to cite the source of a threshold instead of recalling it from memory. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.
name: intrastat_reference
title: INTRASTAT: reference tables and current thresholds
